fields.name: copy
fields.label: Intro Copy
fields.value: Review active AMBER Alerts and share information with law enforcement if you have seen a child or vehicle.

fields.name: apiBaseUrl
fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Laravel backend base URL. The block fetches active alerts from /api/amber-alerts.

fields.name: state
fields.label: Default State Filter
fields.description: Optional two-letter state abbreviation. Leave blank for all active alerts.

fields.name: emptyMessage
fields.label: Empty Message
fields.value: There are no AMBER Alerts at this time.

fields.name: posterPagePath
fields.label: Poster Page Path
fields.description: EDS page containing the Poster Results block. Open Poster links add AMBER query parameters to this path.

fields.name: disclosure
fields.label: Disclosure Text
fields.value: Notice: The National Center for Missing & Exploited Children® certifies the posters on this site only if they contain the NCMEC logo and the 1-800-THE-LOST® (1-800-843-5678) number. All other posters are the responsibility of the agency whose logo appears on the poster.
